question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-3\operatorname{arcsch}⁡4x) \\  & =-3\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡4x) \\  & =-3\cdot (-\frac{1}{|4x|\sqrt{1+(4x)^{2}}})\cdot (4x)^{′} \\  & =3\cdot \frac{1}{4|x|\sqrt{1+16{x}^{2}}}\cdot 4 \\  & =\frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{1+16{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
